title: Project-OS project configuration
description: The nine keys that parameterize the Project-OS skills. Anything not here stays literal in the skill.

tier.description: Decides which OS pieces activate (PROJECT_OS.md Part 7). solo: no board, no queue, no committer hooks.

repo.description: owner/name. Replaces the repo slug hardcoded into every tracker command.

tracker.description: Where the handoff queue lives. 'none' MUST degrade to a file-based queue at docsPath + handoffs/, never break.

verify.description: The command that must pass before a handoff and at session close. Exit 0 = green.

commitStyle.description: numbered = 'NN - description' with the uniqueness guard (BEHAVIOR 7.4); conventional = free subject.

owner.description: Who 'needs owner action' points at in a handoff body.

lanes.description: Team names offered in a handoff body. Empty at solo tier.

docsPath.description: Where the artifact set lives. Some projects use documentation/ or an external wiki.

autoInject.description: Whether the SessionStart injector is active. True asserts it is registered AND an injection has been observed — presence is not registration.
